description: Updates the current user's own profile and preferences. It is a partial update of firstName, lastName, avatarUrl, theme, displayLanguage and formattingLocale; omitted fields keep their current values. It does not change other members or workspace configuration.

avatarUrl.description: HTTPS avatar URL, or '' / null to clear. Omit to keep existing.

displayLanguage.description: Language of the app interface. Omit to keep existing.

formattingLocale.description: Locale for number, date and currency formatting. Omit to keep existing.

theme.description: Colour theme: system, light or dark. Omit to keep existing.

name: update_my_profile
title: Update my profile
